findings.quote: That is usually full-planning territory, not because it is grander, but because someone has to own the gaps.
What you cannot see from Sydney is who answers the email in March, who is standing at the villa gates when the shuttle buses arrive, and where your deposits actually go.
A planner who knows the Chianti hills well may never have moved 90 guests along a lake. / A run sheet shows you how a planner thinks when the schedule slips by 40 minutes.
